No scores, score ranges, rankings, or judge recommendations are assigned here.","The chapter accounting audit reports 55 approximate source families and 111 approximate locators, but those totals do not establish independence or adequacy for every selected lens."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"Terminal no-search evidence review for Sheikh Hasina, Bangladesh, 2023. The notebook contains useful formal, institutional, rights, macroeconomic, humanitarian, and nuclear-program evidence, but defensibility varies substantially by chapter. Chapter 7B has the highest attribution risk because personal-integrity evidence does not establish a personal direction, benefit, or improper-process nexus. Chapters 1B, 5B, 6B, and 8B are stronger on policy context and institutional activity than on independently verified outcomes. Chapters 2B-4B contain more direct adverse and contrary material but retain source-overlap, closed-system, temporal, and remedy gaps. Research rounds were exhausted without full saturation; residual issues and missing themes are preserved for downstream confidence and interpretation, without converting absence into adverse evidence.","schema_version":"ruler_evidence_review_v1","selected_theme_ids":[]}
